body:
ryan_pm: folks — we need to lock scope for the Dedicated autoscale work for next quarter. customer ask from Acme: predictable burst pockets + SLA on degraded fallback. can we sketch acceptance criteria?

ana_eng: request noted. main tradeoff: how big are burst pockets vs isolation overhead. bigger pockets -> easier for customers but hurts density.

vikram_sre: +1. also need to decide eviction policy when cluster is saturated. preempt lowest-priority bursts? preempt by account age?

leila_research: from perf sims: a 1.5x burst cap for 90% of workloads keeps p95 latency within SLA for most models. beyond that cost rises nonlinearly.

maria_ops: Acme explicitly wants "guaranteed availability of burst capacity for business hours" and auditing. that implies reservation window and billing credit if not satisfied. legal asked for clear measurement.

ryan_pm: proposed SLA options to present: 
- Bronze: best-effort burst, no uptime SLA, cheaper
- Silver: 99.9% burst availability during reserved window, can be throttled outside window
- Gold: 99.95% + compensation credit and dedicated eviction protection
Which of these are realistic to ship in Q3?

ana_eng: Bronze + Silver feasible. Gold needs dedicated scheduling & accounting changes (billing + telemetry) — estimates 6-8 sprints.

vikram_sre: to implement Silver we need:
1) a reservation ledger + seat tracker
2) eviction policy (LRU by KV-cache age?)
3) alerting & debug trace for missed bursts
Those are doable in 2-3 sprints with a small SRE pair.

leila_research: also need load-shedding behavior documented. fallback models should be pre-verified for quality drop; include automatic rollback if quality regression > 3% on eval set.

maria_ops: ops items: audit logs, SLA report generator, and billing pipeline changes. billing is the longest pole — finance needs 3 weeks of spec review.

ryan_pm: ok action items:
- ana: scope Silver reservation implementation + API design (owner) — due EOW
- vikram: prototype eviction policy & alerts, and run smoketests — 2w
- leila: produce quality-eval plan for fallback models and define regression threshold — 1w
- maria: draft billing/credit flow w/ finance contact (Jack) — coordinate next Wed

ana_eng: quick API sketch:
```
POST /v1/dedicated/reservations
{ "account_id": "acct_123", "window": "09:00-17:00:TZ", "capacity": {"gpu_credits": 10}, "priority": "silver" }
```
response includes reservation_id and SLA_tier. we should include a "fallback_model" field for automatic routing.

vikram_sre: for eviction, prefer ordered preemption: 1) burst best-effort, 2) bronze reservations, 3) silver reserved (last resort). we'll tag nodes with reservation lanes. need feature flag for rollout.

maria_ops: measurement: define "burst fulfilled" as >= 95% of requested throughput for reservation window. otherwise issue credit. agree?

leila_research: 95% seems OK, but tie it to latency SLO too: if p95 > target for >5% of time during window, treat as breach.

ryan_pm: good. launch criteria draft for Silver:
- functional: reservation API + reservation ledger + routing to lanes
- reliability: 2w of canary in staging with 2 tenants >50% simulated load
- perf: p95 within SLA target for 99% of windows in staging
- observability: SLA dashboard, audit logs, billing events hooked
- legal/finance sign-off on credit policy

maria_ops: add disaster fallback: automatic fallback to hosted multi-tenant with notification and option to apply credit. ops runbook required.

ana_eng: estimate: infra + runtime changes: 5 dev sprints total across teams; to hit Q3 we need to start next week and deprioritize one mid-Q feature unless we add a contractor.

vikram_sre: can we phase rollout? Phase 1: Bronze -> Silver minimal -> Silver GA. Phase 1 minimal is just reservation API + soft enforcement (no credit). Phase 2 add enforcement & credits.

ryan_pm: agreed. product OKR ask: include "Dedicated: ship Silver reservation minimal + canary" as target. we'll list Gold as stretch.

maria_ops: I'll sync with finance on credit mechanics. pinging @jack_finance off-thread.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: infra/ledger-migration -> staging at 1876543300 :rocket:

ana_eng: heading into implementation. will post RFC later today with API params and migration plan.

ryan_pm: thanks. next sync Tue 10:30 for prioritization review. try to keep comments on the RFC so we don't fragment convo. :thumbsup:

leila_research: attaching quick note on eval config in the RFC — will include regression thresholds for each model family.

vikram_sre: logging note: tag all reservation-related traces with reservation_id and lane to make postmortems easier.

maria_ops: noted. I'll add runbook checklist items.

ryan_pm: perfect — closing thread, will pull these into a PRD. if anyone needs blocking resources, shout now.
